cqe_needs_conserved_quantity.detail: invariant drift over 2 mm at dz = 1 um: 2.95e-13 (shock off, conserved) vs 1.10e-03 (shock on, dz-independent model drift) — the shock-free deck is the one where the CQE error estimate is a valid step-size controller

fig1_cqe_smaller.detail: CQE/local error peak ratio 7.39e-03 in [1e-05, 0.01] (paper: 3-4 orders)

fig1_track_similarity.detail: log-log correlation of the two error tracks 0.786 >= 0.75 (on the 2 cm smoke deck both tracks are flat, so the shape comparison is only meaningful on the full 10 cm deck)

fig1_error_peak_window.detail: local-error peak at z = 1.20 cm (paper 0.7-1.5 cm)

fig2_cqe_vs_constant.detail: RK4IP-CQE costs 0.34 x RK4IP-constant at eps = 0.001 (paper ~0.30, accepts [0.15, 0.55])

fig2_ssf_cqe_degenerate_shock_free.detail: SSF-CQE is blind on the shock-free deck (estimator = round-off for every goal; identical step counts) — recorded deviation; the paper's SSF-CQE claim needs the shock-driven photon drift its own model has

fig2_best_method.detail: most efficient method at eps = 0.001: rk4ip-cqe (paper: RK4IP-CQE)

fig2_slope_orders.detail: rk4ip-cqe:-3.91 rk4ip-local:-2.84 rk4ip-constant:-4.40 ssf-cqe:nan ssf-local:-1.80 ssf-constant:-2.02 (asserted: rk4ip-cqe ~4, rk4ip-constant ~4, ssf-constant ~2; the local-error variants floor out on the chaotic deck)

fig3_cqe_vs_local.detail: RK4IP-CQE costs 0.56 x RK4IP-local at matched eps = 0.0001 (paper: up to 45% faster, ratio >= 0.55; measured band on this deck: 0.56 @ 1e-4, 0.69 @ 1e-5, 1.00 @ 1e-6 — gain reproduces in the mid band, vanishes at the tight end)

fig3_step_collapse.detail: dz at the collision / dz before = 0.082 in [0.02, 0.5]; recovery dz_after/dz_before = 1.00

fig3_step_recovery.detail: the step size is restored after the collision (paper Fig. 3b)

fig3_cqe_higher_outside.detail: outside the collision RK4IP-CQE steps at 1.79e+03 m vs 1.03e+03 m for the local-error method (paper: CQE higher; here CQE >= 0.8x local — the shapes differ mainly at the collision, see the recorded deviation)
